timerDuration.name: Timer Duration (minutes)
timerDuration.hint: How long the countdown timer should run before triggering an encounter check

pauseOnCombat.name: Pause on Combat Start
pauseOnCombat.hint: Automatically pause the timer when combat begins

resumeAfterCombat.name: Resume After Combat
resumeAfterCombat.hint: Automatically resume the timer when combat ends

pauseOnGamePause.name: Pause on Game Pause
pauseOnGamePause.hint: Automatically pause the timer when the game is paused

resumeAfterGamePause.name: Resume After Game Unpause
resumeAfterGamePause.hint: Automatically resume the timer when the game is unpaused

advanceCrawlRound.name: Advance Crawl Round on Timer End
advanceCrawlRound.hint: When enabled and in a crawl combat, the crawl round will advance by 1 when the timer completes (Crawl Helper handles encounter checks). When disabled or outside crawl combat, directly triggers an encounter check via Crawl Helper.

showToPlayers.name: Show Timer to Players
showToPlayers.hint: Allow players to see the countdown timer (they won't see control buttons)

notifications.crawlHelperNotActive: Shadow Dark Crawl Helper is not active. Enable it to automatically roll encounters.
notifications.crawlHelperNotFound: Crawl Helper GM Tools not found. Please ensure the Crawl Helper is initialized.
notifications.errorAdvancingRound: Failed to advance crawl round. See console for details.
notifications.errorTriggeringEncounter: Failed to trigger encounter check. See console for details.
